reason: I'm not putting a bot in the group where my staff talk about guests, owners and payments, and I'm not giving it my Google account either. My admin already puts the transfers into a sheet, so $19 a month to swap her for a bot I don't trust isn't worth it to me.
objection: It sits in my work chat and gets into my Google Drive. 'Only sees the folder it creates' is just a promise from a bot I've never heard of. Who is behind it, and where do my receipts and bank screenshots end up?
would_change_my_mind: A version that works without joining the group or logging into my Google account, so I just forward receipts and download the sheet, plus a real company name and a clear data-deletion policy. Then I'd let my admin try the free 30 and see if it actually saves her hours.
